$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — U1 (CP-1): the utility posture reacts to health. The Judge's winners (Suppress, TakeCover, Flee) are utility decisions a check cannot read, so only the parts that show in shots and health are kept: the healthy man fights before the wound (10 s), he fires again after he is healed (30 s), and survives; (2) the defensive pick and (4) the no-flicker rule are not expressible. Health is set by the check, as the old script did (40 at 10 s, 10 at 20 s, 100 at 30 s).
